note: For ChatGPT, Gemini, and any web-based LLM that connects via HTTP.
instructions: 1. Start the server with the command above
2. For ChatGPT: Settings → Beta Features → Tools → Add: http://localhost:8000
3. For Gemini: Extensions → Add tool endpoint: http://localhost:8000
4. Note: web LLMs need a public URL — use ngrok to expose localhost publicly
Use the https://xxx.ngrok.io URL instead of localhost
